Asymmetric editorial split hero with separate readable copy and framed native-scroll media

Source-backed FAQ and real contact/support links

Official slogan, verified content, existing SKU/price/stock authority and real DOM CTAs
Approved Google Flow A→B media; native scroll and static reduced-motion/data-saver fallback
Desktop/mobile browser checks only in bundled headless Chromium with at most two test workers and graceful cleanup
